answer.proposed_action: Assign recording 122398 to denton-tx-health-building-standards-commission without changing official metadata.
answer.rationale: The official agenda linked to recording 122398 explicitly states that the Health and Building Standards Commission of the City of Denton will convene on June 3, 2021, at 3:00 p.m., matching the supplied recording. Under the approved policy, the officially convened body determines ownership; the Council Work Session Room is a venue, not the owner. The existing Health & Building Standards Commission feed matches that body and explicitly includes provider GUID 122398. This supports the recording-specific assignment, without establishing archive completeness.
